{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to secp256k1 build configuration in cmake/secp256k1.cmake purely follow from the vendored subtree changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical build system updates accompanying the secp256k1 module imports do not constitute a build system change."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to doc/descriptors.md and doc/psbt.md accompany the implementation of descriptor and PSBT changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation updates that merely document new feature behavior belong to their functional areas rather than docs."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/chainparams.cpp only to add regtest activation parameters for BIP460.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Updating deployment parameters inside kernel chainparams without modifying kernel interfaces or boundaries does not make this a kernel PR."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements mempool standardness and policy rules for witness version 2 CISA spends in src/policy/policy.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Defines policy standardness rules for witness v2 transactions to support cross-input signature aggregation safely before full activation. Policy rules for experimental soft fork proposals provide a clear specification for transaction relay and acceptance."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches test/functional/mining_basic.py for test compatibility with witness v2 transactions.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "No mining interfaces, block assembly logic, or getblocktemplate RPCs are touched."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches test/functional/p2p_segwit.py purely to update test coverage for segwit v2.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not change peer-to-peer network transport, message handling, or connection management."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp and src/rpc/util.cpp to expose CISA PSBT support.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Changes to RPC methods merely expose PSBT and script validation features implemented in wallet and consensus."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds functional and unit test harnesses such as test/functional/test_framework/cisa.py dedicated to testing CISA.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Tests validating specific new consensus, wallet, and policy logic belong to their respective functional areas, not general test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Updates the vendored libsecp256k1 subtree with experimental BIP458 half-aggregation and BIP459 full-aggregation modules.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Vendors unmerged upstream libsecp256k1 modules (bitcoin-core/secp256k1#1566 and #1754) to provide signature aggregation primitives. Subtree updates for prospective cryptographic standards are worthwhile for testing and specification validation."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements consensus script verification for witness version 2 outputs and check-queue batching in src/script/interpreter.cpp and src/validation.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Provides the consensus reference implementation for BIP460 Cross-Input Signature Aggregation. As a proposed soft fork, evaluating its consensus rules and validation security is strategically important for the project's consensus roadmap."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds `cisa()` descriptor parsing and wallet signing integration using half- and full-aggregation across src/wallet/ and src/psbt.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds wallet descriptor and PSBT support for Taproot key path spends with aggregated signatures to enable multi-party transaction construction. It demonstrates and exercises end-to-end wallet signing for collaborative transactions under BIP460."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 2,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
